coaching.headline: We won a big mid-game fight, then handed it all back chasing into their jungle for nothing.
coaching.team: Three lanes were favored, and at 20.2 we won a real team fight (5-3) — that should have been the snowball. Instead we immediately over-extended: the 21.6 fight at their Fangtooth (1-3, four of us into a place we couldn't hold) and the 22.2 follow (0-2, opened two bodies down) gave it straight back, and Grux's team took Fangtooth, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth on the bounce. The game ended on another bad trade — a 29-min 3-man deep in their jungle (1-3). Grux was the threat — 11 kills and 34k damage. The towers say it plainly: 2 to their 10. After winning at 20.2, the call was to take an objective on OUR terms, not to dive their Fangtooth.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Throwing the 20.2 fight we won (5-3) by immediately diving their Fangtooth at 21.6 (1-3) and 22.2 (0-2) — which handed them four straight majors and the map.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The Fey was our best lane — 7 kills, favored, with early kills on Kwang and Grux. Then came the pull into the 21.6 dive on their Fangtooth (1-3) right after the team had won at 20.2. Mr_Meat31 had the lead; the move was to keep pressuring where The Fey was strong, not to follow into their jungle.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Phase died 4 times and carried no magic resist into a 3-magical comp (the flag), which is why Phase got deleted in the fights. Goldilocks324 was in the 21.6 Fangtooth throw and was already dead when the 22.2 follow started 2v4. As support, Goldilocks324 is the one who should be pinging off a dive into their territory after a won fight — that's where the game slipped.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Lt. Belica was the unfavored lane (Gideon owned it all game) and 7 deaths showed it. Cuban Noobster was in every losing fight — 21.6, 22.2, and the 29-min throw deep in their jungle (1-3). With the lane behind, the job is zone-control from the back, not being in the front of dives into their half.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Skylar had the early edge and a clean stat line (4/3/6), but Willy Guggenheim wasn't there for the close — at 29.1 the macro flags the carry alive and never joining. The Vanquisher landed at 25 and Plasma Blade at 30; with the team throwing leads, that damage needed to be present in those team fights to punish, not split off.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Feng Mao was favored but Xeebs died 8 times and ran no magic resist into a 3-magical comp. The macro flags him alive and never joining the 21.6 fight; he fell in the 22.2 follow and the 29-min jungle throw. The jungler sets the pace — after winning at 20.2, the read was to ward and take a safe objective, not to keep diving Grux's team on their side.

threats: Chain-CC risk (5 hard-CC abilities, ~3.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.

ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight

ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling

ourKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult

ourKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
ourKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
ourKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

lines: Lead story: Fury of the Heavens on a short timer. Fury of the Heavens came back every ~56s instead of 85s, 35% faster.
Fury of the Heavens at rank 3: 85s base, about 55.6s by the end (35% shorter) from 53 ability haste: Magnify 15, Prophecy 15, Flux Matrix 15, Tempest 8.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Kwang dealt 12,304 hero damage, 13% of their team's, with +210 magical power from items.
Prophecy (item): On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage On-Hit.
Flux Matrix (item): Nearby Enemy Heroes: Take 10% additional Magical Damage. Have their Tenacity decreased by 50%.
World Breaker (item): On dealing Magical Damage to a Hero: Increases your Magical Damage dealt by 2% for 4.5s. Stacks up to 6 times.
Tempest (crest): Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.
Slayer of the Heavens (augment): Strike of the Heavens deals 25% more damage and reduces Cooldowns by 25% more.

Sustain: 8% omnivamp; Tempest: Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.; 2,261 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1050 health, +45 magical armor, +25% tenacity; took 29,947 damage, mitigated 21,685, died 3 times.

Loadout augment Slayer of the Heavens: Your energized lightning basic attacks hit harder and cut your cooldowns more. Weave a basic attack after every ability so Judgement and Surge come back faster. (game text: Strike of the Heavens deals 25% more damage and reduces Cooldowns by 25% more.) (changes Strike of the Heavens) Field: 48.9% in 4240 games, 79% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout crest Tempest: Zaps up to 3 nearby heroes every second and heals you. Pop it as you dive in with Surge of the Heavens to help you survive in the middle of a fight. (game text: Overcharge:  Deal 15 (+15%) Damage to 3 nearby Heroes every second for 7s. Heal equal to 35% of the damage dealt. Additional hits against the same Target deal 20% Damage.) Field: 48.3% in 2609 games, 49% of picks, level the hero-role's 48.9%.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Magnify, Tempest.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Magnify, Flux Matrix. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 0 of the 1 players Kwang killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Skylar, Feng Mao. We killed Kwang 3 times.
Copy it? Too few Kwang offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

card.lesson: Fury of the Heavens came back about every 56s instead of 85s by the end (35% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
